decision: Among models within .005 of best source-validation macro F1, prefer fewer fault→normal errors, then fewer parameters.
basis: Source validation only; no target benchmark used to select the initial component
architecture_constraint: User-confirmed hybrid research design. RF-only is included as a reference; no claim that adding temporal modeling is beneficial when scores do not improve.
risk: False normal predictions and unsupported transfer remain consequential. All target requests require review.
latency_requirement: 95/100 full warm UI requests under5s; measured separately
hardware_cost: Not metered; zero API charge does not imply free compute.
complexity: All share RF+TCN. Attention and combined summaries add parameters, versioned calibration, and deployment code.
